summary: Make active persona requirements from persona owner (GET /api/personas) part of the controller's authoritative desired state alongside deployment defaults, failing closed on owner failure without retiring active persona connectors.

incident_context.symptom: Connector schedule for dev-paper-us-equity-simulation toggled enabled=true then enabled=false within 7-45s across 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07 deploys
incident_context.root_cause: The source-ingestion controller tick read only static default_desired_state.json as desired state authority; active persona connector requirements provisioned by bootstrap were missing from the static file, causing the controller's next periodic tick to classify them as unwanted and retire the connector schedule

hosted_dry_run_finding.reconcile_error_detail: singleton connector cannot prove multiple persona data requirements: dev-paper-us-equity-simulation (persona-070a7b24589fb129f052:US:us_price_daily:daily:live_pull:dev-paper-us-equity-simulation, persona-0a1283ddf9a0fdb7ad33:...)
hosted_dry_run_finding.resolution: Derive distinct live requirements from active personas and attach them once to deployment requirement holder persona-source-ingest-public-market; align bootstrap first-tick shortcut to the same holder identity so both converge on one binding key

acceptance_verification.ac1_authoritative_desired_state_merges_p: passed: controller_worker.load_desired_state derives distinct live requirements from active personas and attaches them to deployment holder persona-source-ingest-public-market alongside static defaults
acceptance_verification.ac2_retired_personas_retire_connectors: passed: _is_active_persona excludes personas with lifecycle_state == 'retired' or status in {'retired', 'archived'}; retiring the persona causes the reconciler to disable its schedule on the next tick
acceptance_verification.ac3_fail_closed_on_persona_owner_read_fa: passed: persona owner read failure, non-200 HTTP status, or malformed list payload raises ControllerTickError with stage='persona_owner_read' and retires nothing (never falls back to static default file alone)
acceptance_verification.ac4_docker_compose_wiring: passed: docker-compose.yml configures source-ingest-scheduler with SOURCE_INGEST_DESIRED_STATE_URL=${SOURCE_INGEST_DESIRED_STATE_URL:-http://persona:8002/api/personas} and SOURCE_INGEST_DESIRED_STATE_BEARER_TOKEN=${PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN:-pantheon-local-persona-service-token}, verified by scripts/test_deploy_nonprod_vm.py
acceptance_verification.ac5_two_controller_ticks_preserve_schedu: passed: test_two_controller_ticks_preserve_active_persona_simulation_schedule asserts schedule for dev-paper-us-equity-simulation stays enabled across consecutive ticks with exactly one binding when 3 active personas share the requirement, and retires connector when all are retired
acceptance_verification.ac6_read_failure_preserves_connectors_an: passed: test_persona_owner_read_failure_leaves_every_connector_and_schedule_unchanged asserts controller tick fails closed with stage='persona_owner_read' and preserves connector configs and schedules exactly
acceptance_verification.ac7_bootstrap_docstring_clarification: passed: scripts/bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py uses DEPLOYMENT_REQUIREMENT_HOLDER_ID for ensure_source_provisioning first-tick shortcut so it converges with the controller's authoritative binding key
acceptance_verification.ac8_connector_schedule_history_recorded: passed: incident context, root cause, and hosted dry-run 400 error recorded in evidence.json documenting toggle history and singleton connector resolution
acceptance_verification.ac9_net_prod_line_budget: passed: net production code diff is <= 120 lines (+44 net lines across controller_worker.py, docker-compose.yml, bootstrap_dev_paper_baseline.py)
acceptance_verification.ac10_hosted_track_external_wait: recorded: hosted track recorded as external_wait pending non-prod deployment verification
